# SDF — Stacked Diffs Flow

> A CLI tool for managing stacked pull requests on GitHub.
> SDF automates cascade rebasing, keeps PR bases in sync, and provides
> AI-powered conflict resolution and branch splitting via Claude.

## What SDF does

SDF manages "stacked diffs" — chains of dependent pull requests where each
PR builds on the previous one. When an upstream PR merges, SDF rebases every
downstream branch, updates GitHub PR bases, and optionally uses Claude to
resolve conflicts and generate PR content.

## Key commands

- `sdf new` — Create a new stack and its first branch
- `sdf branch` — Add a branch to the current stack
- `sdf pr` — Open a GitHub PR with stack navigation links
- `sdf sync` — Cascade-rebase after upstream merges, update PR bases
- `sdf merge` — Squash-merge the head PR and rebase the rest
- `sdf split` — Decompose a large branch into a stack of focused PRs using AI
- `sdf status` — View stack topology and sync state
- `sdf fetch` — Import existing PR stacks from GitHub
- `sdf move` — Relocate commits between branches in a stack
- `sdf ai intro` — Set up Claude Code integration for SDF

## Source repository

## Installation

```
brew install pavelpascari/tap/sdf
```

Or: `go install github.com/pavelpascari/sdf@latest`
